title: Practice Friend Requests
description: Welcome to your Practice Social Feed! You have a few new friend requests. Look closely at their profiles to decide if they are real people you know, or if they might be a fake copycat profile. You cannot break anything here!

requests.name: Martha (Your best friend)
requests.bio: I had to make a new account! Add me here.

requests.name: Robert Davis
requests.bio: Retired teacher. Love gardening and reading.

requests.name: Dr. William Anderson
requests.bio: Surgeon working overseas on a peacekeeping mission. Looking for a kind soul.

gentleFailureCloned.title: Oops! That was a copycat profile.
gentleFailureCloned.message:
In the real world, accepting that request could let a scammer pretend to be your friend. But **here in the simulator, you are completely safe!**

Scammers often copy a real friend's picture and name to trick you. Notice how this new 'Martha' account was created *today* and has *zero* friends in common? If a current friend suddenly sends a new request, it is always safest to click 'Decline', then call your real friend on the phone to ask if they made a new page. Let's try the next one!

gentleFailureStranger.title: Oops! That request was from a stranger.
gentleFailureStranger.message:
You accepted a request from someone you don't know who has *zero* mutual friends and just joined yesterday. In the real world, scammers often invent fake jobs (like 'overseas doctor') to build trust and eventually ask for money.

It is always safest to only accept friend requests from people you actually know in real life. Let's take a deep breath and try again!

gentleFailureDeclineReal.title: You clicked 'Decline'. That is always your right!
gentleFailureDeclineReal.message:
It is completely fine to decline any request! You never have to connect with anyone if you don't want to.

However, notice that Robert's profile was older (Joined 2014) and he shared 4 friends in common with you. This usually means it's a real person from your local community. Let's keep going!

success.title: Fantastic job!
success.message:
You successfully protected your social circle! By checking when the account was created and looking for 'Friends in Common', you easily spotted the fake copycat profile and the scammer.

You are learning exactly how to stay safe online. Wonderful work!
